description.value: Lavington Outdoor Pool is a free, publicly accessible outdoor swimming pool operated by the City of Vernon, located in the Lavington area near Coldstream. It offers a refreshing stop for touring cyclists riding through the North Okanagan, particularly welcome on hot summer days in the valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is mostly navigation/menu text from the City of Vernon site with very little actual content about the Lavington Outdoor Pool itself. OSM tags confirm it is an outdoor swimming pool at 6401 Lavington Way, tagged as free (fee=no) and publicly accessible (access=yes). No specific amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, showers, etc.) are mentioned in the website content or OSM tags, so most amenity fields remain null. As a free outdoor municipal pool, it is a reasonable attraction for touring cyclists passing through Coldstream/Lavington.
concerns: Website content scraped was mostly site navigation with minimal pool-specific information; amenities could not be verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A free, public outdoor pool is a useful and appealing stop for touring cyclists in the Okanagan heat. Amenity details are unconfirmed but the facility itself is a clear fit for the directory.

wow_evidence: Free outdoor public pool; outdoor-pool anchor band.
blurb: Free outdoor pool in Lavington, east of Vernon.
